question: Pt. Bhimsen Joshi has received highest civilian award Bharat Ratna in which of the following year?
solution:
The correct answer is __**2009**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Pt. Bhimsen Joshi** received the highest civilian award, Bharat Ratna, in the year **2009**.
 
• The Bharat Ratna is the highest civilian award of the Republic of India, instituted in **1954**.
 
• It is awarded in recognition of exceptional service/performance of the highest order, without distinction of race, occupation, position, or sex.
 
• Recipients receive a **Sanad (certificate) signed by the President of India** and a medallion.
 
• Pt. Bhimsen Joshi was a renowned Indian vocalist in the Hindustani classical tradition.
 
• His contributions to Indian classical music have been immense and widely recognized.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Bharat Ratna** award was initially limited to achievements in the arts, literature, science, and public services, but the government expanded the criteria to include "any field of human endeavor" in **2011**.
 
• The award does not carry any monetary grant or special benefits.
 
• Other notable recipients of the Bharat Ratna include **Mother Teresa, Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam, Sachin Tendulkar,** and **Nelson Mandela**.
 
• As of 2023, **48 individuals** have been honored with the Bharat Ratna.
